fursona.colors: Typical husky black and white fur
fursona.description: An anthro husky with typical black and white fur, white feathery angelic wings and a halo over his head.

conventions: He has been to several furry conventions
personality: Friendly with all of his contacts.

online.muck_desc: A young anthro husky stands here, his thick fur the classic husky black and white: dark across his back, ears and the top of his head, bright white on his muzzle, chest and belly. A pair of white, feathery angelic wings fold neatly against his back, and a soft golden halo floats just above his ears, bobbing whenever his tail wags - which is often. His pale blue eyes are friendly and curious, and he looks like he's always up for a chat.
